[HV-R1 complete-verdict-prose part 4/34]
ontext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:632; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1016; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-003-AC001.
A probe started for configuration A can finish after PATCH changes the reviewer to configuration B, then CloseHvRunOutputCommand unconditionally marks B Online (632, 1016). No captured reviewer configuration version exists on HvRun (484-490), nor does the probe close compare one. Readiness must bind to the configuration actually probed; add a stale-probe race criterion.

F05: FAIL. Probe failures enter a request-only retry policy. Classification: implementer edit.
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:484; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1045; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1346; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1395; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-003-AC003; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-009.
FailHvRunCommand always calls the review-request-only HvRetryDecision (1045-1067, 1346), although a Probe has no HvRequestId (484) and a failed launch or nonzero probe exit uses this same command (1395). The probe failure and shutdown outcomes require an explicit branch, with offline/incident and retry semantics tested.

F06: FAIL. Reviewer-turn verification accepts an incomplete or open audit turn. Classification: implementer edit.
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:166; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:544; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:553; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1283; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-010; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC010.
V-6 accepts a reviewer turn containing only the compact hv_verdict (1283, 553). It does not require the entire result or a closed Chore turn, as P-06 and the brief require (544). A persisted summary-only or open turn can pass finalization. Verification and negative criteria must check the complete result and required terminal state.

F07: FAIL. The stored result contains its own unspecified content hash. Classification: implementer edit.
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:494; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:562; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-011; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-015.
HvEvidence stores the result document with only responseLog removed (494), while that document contains evidence.result.sha256 (562), and its Sha256 hashes the decompressed stored bytes (494). No exclusion/projection defines a hashable payload without its own hash. Define one canonical stored payload and add its digest to the returned envelope, with a named hash/round-trip case.

F08: FAIL. Incident filing writes before the audit hard-stop guard. Classification: implementer edit.
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:369; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1156; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1165; FR-MCP-HVPIPE-018-AC002.
FileHvIncidentCommand calls the writing triage service before AuditLedgerGuard (1156, 1163-1171), contrary to the hard-stop rule that no HV unit writes while the ledger is unavailable (369, FR-MCP-HVPIPE-018-AC002). Its diagram also puts Filed and notification writes after an edge labeled committed. The guard and audited triage write need an enforceable ordering/transaction boundary, and the diagram must put local outcome and notification inside the transaction.

F09: FAIL. P1 misstates the live requirement satisfaction flag. Classification: implementer edit.
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:2509; REMED-HVPIPELINE-001/P1; FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003/acceptanceCriteria[3]; docs/receipts/hv/hv-r1-related-requirements.json:82.
P1 states that FR-MCP-HOSTILEREVIEW-003 criterion 4 is satisfied (amendment 2509; REMED-HVPIPELINE-001 P1). The live requirement read has isSatisfied false (hv-r1-related-requirements.json:82-84). Correct the factual claim in both artifacts, retaining the independently verified missing-worker defect. Do not change the store to fit the claim.

F10: FAIL. The retained model-grade contract cannot execute inside finalization. Classification: implementer edit.
Location: docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:183; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:187; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture-Amendment-1-Durable-HV.md:1100; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture.md:3383; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture.md:3386; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture.md:3410; docs/architecture/SessionTurn-Review-AgentContext-Architecture.md:3445.
A-05 leaves the foundation model-grade input and guards incompatible with its new caller (amendment 183, 1100, 1178; foundation 3383, 3386, 3410, 3426, 3445). The request must be Open in the retained foundation contract, but finalization calls it while Finalizing. The old DTO still requires removed receipt paths and thread fields; its pre-write staleness dispatch expects no transaction, whereas the new call is inside one. Replace the complete internal grade contract, guards, side effects, and diagrams, including responsibility for completing the outer request. A-09 also names section 3.1 for a check actually in 6.3 (foundation 2842).

F11: FAIL. Response findings cannot satisfy or survive the result contract. Classification: impl
